package.description: Manage localization of all ResX-based resources in your solution.

en-US.description: Manage localization of all ResX-based resources in your solution.
en-US.longDescription:
ResX Resource Manager is a standalone Windows desktop application that lets you
manage localizations for all ResX-based resources across your solution. It provides
a single view of all resource files, supports automatic translations via DeepL,
Google Translate, Azure Cognitive Services, and OpenAI, and can export/import
resources to/from Excel.
en-US.name: ResX Resource Manager
